cancer_indication: Metastatic HER2-positive breast cancer after ≥2 prior anti-HER2 regimens (≥1 in the metastatic setting), given in combination with chemotherapy.
moa: Margetuximab binds the HER2 (ERBB2) extracellular domain (same epitope as trastuzumab) and inhibits HER2 signaling, reducing downstream pathway activation. Its Fc region is engineered to increase affinity for activating FcγRIIIa (CD16A; FCGR3A) and decrease affinity for inhibitory FcγRIIb (CD32B; FCGR2B), enhancing NK cell- and macrophage-mediated tumor killing (ADCC and phagocytosis). Fc-mediated immune activation is linked to cytokine release (e.g., IFN-γ) and interferon-stimulated signaling in the tumor microenvironment.

KEGG_ERBB_SIGNALING_PATHWAY.description: Canonical HER family receptor signaling (including HER2) that propagates growth and survival signals through RAS–MAPK and PI3K–AKT nodes.
KEGG_ERBB_SIGNALING_PATHWAY.interpretation: ERBB signaling is the core oncogenic driver in HER2-amplified breast cancers and underpins dependence on HER2-directed antibody therapy.

REACTOME_ERBB2_SIGNALING.description: HER2/ERBB2-driven signaling network in cancer, including receptor dimerization and downstream kinase cascades controlling proliferation and survival.
REACTOME_ERBB2_SIGNALING.interpretation: ERBB2 signaling is central to the malignant phenotype in HER2-positive breast cancer and provides the primary biological context for anti-HER2 antibodies.

REACTOME_DOWNREGULATION_OF_ERBB2_SIGNALI.description: Processes that attenuate HER2 signaling via receptor internalization, ubiquitination, trafficking, and degradation, limiting receptor availability and signaling output.
REACTOME_DOWNREGULATION_OF_ERBB2_SIGNALI.interpretation: Regulation of HER2 receptor abundance and signaling duration is relevant to antibody-based HER2 targeting, where receptor down-modulation can contribute to pathway suppression.

HALLMARK_PI3K_AKT_MTOR_SIGNALING.description: Gene set reflecting PI3K–AKT–mTOR pathway activity governing cellular growth, metabolism, and survival signaling programs.
HALLMARK_PI3K_AKT_MTOR_SIGNALING.interpretation: PI3K–AKT–mTOR signaling is a major downstream survival axis of HER2 that shapes tumor biology in HER2-positive breast cancer.

KEGG_NATURAL_KILLER_CELL_MEDIATED_CYTOTO.description: NK-cell activation and cytotoxic effector mechanisms (including Fc receptor-triggered activation) that mediate killing of antibody-opsonized target cells.
KEGG_NATURAL_KILLER_CELL_MEDIATED_CYTOTO.interpretation: NK-cell effector function is mechanistically relevant to IgG1 anti-HER2 therapies that leverage antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity as part of anti-tumor activity.

REACTOME_FCGAMMA_RECEPTOR_FCGR_DEPENDENT.description: Fcγ receptor-dependent recognition and engulfment of antibody-opsonized targets by phagocytes, including signaling events downstream of FcγR engagement.
REACTOME_FCGAMMA_RECEPTOR_FCGR_DEPENDENT.interpretation: FcγR-dependent phagocytosis is relevant to anti-HER2 antibodies by supporting macrophage-mediated clearance of opsonized tumor cells as an immune effector mechanism.

HALLMARK_INTERFERON_GAMMA_RESPONSE.description: Interferon-γ-induced gene program reflecting cytokine-driven immune activation and interferon-stimulated transcriptional responses.
HALLMARK_INTERFERON_GAMMA_RESPONSE.interpretation: IFN-γ-linked immune signaling can reflect immune activation associated with antibody-triggered effector responses in the tumor microenvironment.

sensitivity_genes_up_annotations.interpretation: High HER2 expression/amplification is a prerequisite for clinical use because pivotal trials restrict to HER2-positive tumors (IHC 3+ or ISH-amplified).

Clinical analyses describe improved relative outcomes with margetuximab vs trastuzumab concentrated in patients carrying at least one CD16A-158F allele, consistent with Fc-engineering designed to enhance CD16A engagement.

resistance_genes_down_annotations.interpretation: PTEN loss is described as a classical HER2-targeted resistance mechanism (class-level) linked to reduced dependence on extracellular HER2 signaling via downstream pathway activation; margetuximab-specific gene-level resistance datasets are noted as lacking.

Breast_cancer_subtype_information.Metastatic HER2-positive breast cancer (: SOPHIA and the Chinese phase II bridging study included HER2-positive advanced/metastatic breast cancer with mixed HR-positive and HR-negative patients; reports describe similar relative benefit across HR strata, and margetuximab is used regardless of hormone receptor status in HER2-positive metastatic disease after prior anti-HER2 regimens.
Breast_cancer_subtype_information.Early-stage HER2-positive breast cancer: As of 2024–2025, no approved early-stage indication is stated; a phase II neoadjuvant trial (MARGOT, NCT04425018) comparing paclitaxel/margetuximab/pertuzumab vs paclitaxel/trastuzumab/pertuzumab is described with results not yet mature.
Breast_cancer_subtype_information.HER2-low (HR+ or HR\u2212): No published dedicated margetuximab trials are described; no clinically meaningful HER2-low breast cancer cohorts with outcome data are noted.
Breast_cancer_subtype_information.Triple-negative (HER2-negative) breast c: Margetuximab is described as appearing in early-phase basket trials that included TNBC and other tumors, but without clear breast-specific efficacy reporting; no current rationale to use in HER2-negative TNBC outside a trial is stated.

notes: Gene-level sensitivity is explicitly described for ERBB2 (HER2 positivity as a prerequisite) and FCGR3A (CD16A-158F allele subgroup benefit); other putative biomarkers are described as conceptual and not rigorously quantified. Dedicated resistance-omics datasets specific to margetuximab in breast cancer are explicitly described as lacking; PTEN loss is mentioned only as a class-level HER2-targeted resistance mechanism.
